title: Vegan German Squash Casserole
description: A delicious and hearty vegan casserole made with roasted squash and German-inspired flavors.
instructions: Peel and chop the squash into 1-inch cubes.
Toss the squash with 1 tbsp of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast the squash in the oven for 25-30 minutes, or until tender.
While the squash is roasting, sauté the onion and garlic in 1 tbsp of olive oil until softened.
Add the vegan sauerkraut to the pan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the roasted squash, sauerkraut mixture, and cubed bread.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle the nutritional yeast on top of the casserole.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
